# signbit32

> Return a boolean indicating if the sign bit for a signed 32-bit integer is on (true) or off (false).

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var signbit32 = require( '@stdlib/number/int32/base/signbit' );
```

#### signbit32( x )

Returns a boolean indicating if the sign bit for a signed 32-bit integer is on (`true`) or off (`false`).

```javascript
var bool = signbit32( 4 );
// returns false

bool = signbit32( -4 );
// returns true

bool = signbit32( 0 );
// returns false

bool = signbit32( -0 );
// returns false
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var float64ToInt32 = require( '@stdlib/number/float64/base/to-int32' );
var randu = require( '@stdlib/random/base/randu' );
var signbit32 = require( '@stdlib/number/int32/base/signbit' );

var sign;
var x;
var i;

for ( i = 0; i < 100; i++ ) {
    x = float64ToInt32( (randu()*100.0) - 50.0 );
    sign = signbit32( x );
    sign = ( sign ) ? 'true' : 'false';
    console.log( 'x: %d. signbit: %s.', x, sign );
}
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
